sessions.title: A Different ‘cause’ verbs
sessions.description_vi: Giới thiệu các động từ khác nhau để diễn tả nguyên nhân và kết quả.
sessions.value:
# Talking about cause and effect

## A Different ‘cause’ verbs

| topic                                         | verb            | examples                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| negative events, situations and feelings      | **cause**       | The storm **caused chaos / havoc / a lot of damage**. Her remarks **caused alarm / concern**. Her son’s behaviour **caused her great anxiety / a lot of embarrassment**. |
| positive and negative changes                 | **bring about** | The discovery of X-rays **brought about a revolution / transformation** in medical science. The events **brought about the downfall / collapse** of the government.      |
| positive and negative situations and feelings | **create**      | Her book helped **create awareness** of inner-city poverty. Your presence on the committee is **creating problems** for all of us.                                       |
| sudden, often negative, events                | **spark off**   | The announcement **sparked off riots / demonstrations** in the cities. His wife’s absence **sparked off rumours** in the media.                                          |
| reactions from people                         | **attract**     | His book has **attracted a lot of criticism / interest**. The charity appeal **attracted support** from a wide range of people.                                          |
| results and effects                           | **produce**     | My comments **produced the opposite effect** to what I intended. Her research has not yet **produced any results**, but we must wait.                                    |

sessions.title: B Causes and effects
sessions.description_vi: Trình bày các cụm từ thông dụng để nói về nguyên nhân và kết quả.
sessions.value:
## B Causes and effects

|                                                                           |                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| The **immediate cause** of the problem was an oil leak.                   | The **underlying cause** of the problem was a lack of funds over many years.                     |
| The government hopes to **reduce/minimise the impact** of the new taxes.  | The support she got from the Prime Minister **strengthened/increased the impact** of her report. |
| The new measures had an **unexpected/unforeseen outcome**.                | The new tax led to the **predictable/inevitable outcome** that many people became poorer.        |
| The **positive/beneficial effects** of the changes were soon apparent.    | The **negative/adverse effects** of the changes were not noticed immediately.                    |
| The crisis was the **direct/inevitable result** of bad economic planning. | One **indirect/unforeseen result** of the new laws has been a rise in unemployment.              |

sessions.title: C Common expressions for everyday events
sessions.description_vi: Giới thiệu các thành ngữ phổ biến để diễn tả các sự kiện hàng ngày liên quan đến nguyên nhân và kết quả.
sessions.value:
## C Common expressions for everyday events

The book **caused an uproar** in the United States. [made a lot of people complain angrily]
If you make her angry, you’ll have to **suffer the consequences**.
The accident **had a huge effect** on her life.
Latino singers have **had a major impact** on pop music this year.
Remember that it **makes/creates a bad impression** if you’re late.
The drug companies **have a lot of influence** on doctors.
Their love affair **caused a sensation**.

**Common mistakes**

To _affect_ means ‘to have an influence on someone/something, or to cause them to change’. (Her death **affected everyone deeply**.) To _effect_ means ‘to achieve something / make something happen’. (We are trying to **effect a change** in the way people think about their diet.) The noun _effect(s)_ refers to the result(s) of something. (His stressful life has had an **effect** on his health.)

sections.instruction_vi: Tìm hiểu các thành ngữ phổ biến để diễn tả các sự kiện hàng ngày liên quan đến nguyên nhân và kết quả, đồng thời phân biệt cách sử dụng của 'affect' và 'effect'.

content_items.value:

To _affect_ means ‘to have an influence on someone/something, or to cause them to change’. (Her death **affected everyone deeply**.) To _effect_ means ‘to achieve something / make something happen’. image.value: An image representing the concept of cause and effect, perhaps a domino effect or a chain reaction.

senses.definition_vi: Gây ra, là nguyên nhân của một sự kiện, tình huống hoặc cảm xúc tiêu cực.
examples: The storm caused chaos / havoc / a lot of damage.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng với các sự kiện, tình huống hoặc cảm xúc tiêu cực.

senses.definition_vi: Nguyên nhân của một sự kiện hoặc tình huống.
examples: The immediate cause of the problem was an oil leak.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Được sử dụng để chỉ nguồn gốc hoặc lý do của một điều gì đó.

use_prompts.question: What problems does heavy rain bring to cities?
Why is smoking so dangerous?
Why is unemployment a serious problem?

dictation.text: The storm caused a lot of damage.

paraphrase.source: The storm led to chaos in the city.
paraphrase.model: The storm caused chaos in the city.

paraphrase.source: Smoking is the main reason for lung cancer.
paraphrase.model: Smoking is the main cause of lung cancer.

image.value: An image symbolizing change or transformation, like a caterpillar turning into a butterfly or a seed growing into a plant.

senses.definition_vi: Mang lại, gây ra (thường là những thay đổi lớn, tích cực hoặc tiêu cực).
examples: The discovery of X-rays brought about a revolution / transformation in medical science.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để chỉ những thay đổi quan trọng hoặc có ảnh hưởng sâu rộng.

use_prompts.question: How has the internet changed the way we live?
What changes did vaccines lead to in medicine?
How can ordinary people change society?

dictation.text: Technology can bring about big changes in society.

paraphrase.source: The discovery of X-rays led to a revolution in medical science.
paraphrase.model: The discovery of X-rays helped to bring about a revolution in medical science.

paraphrase.source: Peaceful protests can lead to real change in society.
paraphrase.model: Peaceful protests can bring about real change in society.

image.value: An image of an artist painting or a sculptor working, representing the act of creation.

senses.definition_vi: Tạo ra, gây ra (thường là các tình huống, cảm xúc hoặc nhận thức).
examples: Her book helped create awareness of inner-city poverty.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Có thể dùng cho cả tình huống tích cực và tiêu cực, thường liên quan đến việc hình thành một cái gì đó mới.

use_prompts.question: How can films and books help people understand social problems?
How can governments reduce unemployment?
How can architects make homes feel more spacious?

dictation.text: Her book helped create awareness of poverty.

paraphrase.source: Her book helped make people aware of inner-city poverty.
paraphrase.model: Her book helped create awareness of inner-city poverty.

paraphrase.source: The new factory will bring hundreds of jobs to the town.
paraphrase.model: The new factory will create hundreds of jobs in the town.

image.value: An image of a spark igniting something, like a firework or a small explosion.

senses.definition_vi: Châm ngòi, khơi mào (thường là các sự kiện đột ngột, thường là tiêu cực).
examples: The announcement sparked off riots / demonstrations in the cities.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả một sự kiện nhỏ hoặc hành động ban đầu gây ra một chuỗi các sự kiện lớn hơn, thường là bạo lực hoặc hỗn loạn.

use_prompts.question: Why do protests sometimes turn violent?
How can a single social media post lead to a big argument?
What events can lead to a sudden financial crisis?

dictation.text: The decision sparked off protests across the country.

paraphrase.source: The announcement suddenly led to riots in the cities.
paraphrase.model: The announcement sparked off riots in the cities.

paraphrase.source: A single comment online started a huge argument.
paraphrase.model: A single comment online sparked off a huge argument.

image.value: An image of a magnet pulling metal objects towards it, symbolizing attraction.

senses.definition_vi: Thu hút (sự chú ý, sự chỉ trích, sự ủng hộ, v.v.).
examples: His book has attracted a lot of criticism / interest.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc thu hút phản ứng hoặc sự quan tâm từ người khác.

use_prompts.question: Why do some books or films receive a lot of criticism?
How can a city bring in more tourists?
How can poor regions get more investment?

dictation.text: The new museum attracts many visitors.

paraphrase.source: His book has received a lot of criticism.
paraphrase.model: His book has attracted a lot of criticism.

paraphrase.source: The festival brings in thousands of tourists every year.
paraphrase.model: The festival attracts thousands of tourists every year.

image.value: An image of a factory conveyor belt with finished goods, symbolizing production.

senses.definition_vi: Sản xuất ra, tạo ra (kết quả, hiệu ứng).
examples: My comments produced the opposite effect to what I intended.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để chỉ kết quả hoặc hiệu ứng của một hành động hoặc quá trình.

use_prompts.question: Do strict punishments in schools have the desired effect?
Do warning labels on cigarettes really work?
Do bonuses actually improve employees' results?

dictation.text: The new medicine produced good results.

paraphrase.source: My comments had the opposite effect to what I intended.
paraphrase.model: My comments produced the opposite effect to what I intended.

paraphrase.source: The new teaching method led to excellent results.
paraphrase.model: The new teaching method produced excellent results.

image.value: An image showing the final trigger of an event, like a hand pushing the first domino.

senses.definition_vi: Nguyên nhân trực tiếp, nguyên nhân ngay lập tức.
examples: The immediate cause of the problem was an oil leak.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ nguyên nhân trực tiếp dẫn đến một kết quả, thường là nguyên nhân dễ thấy nhất.

use_prompts.question: What directly leads to flooding in cities?
What usually triggers a heart attack?
Why do most car accidents happen?

dictation.text: The immediate cause of the fire was a cigarette.

paraphrase.source: The direct reason for the problem was an oil leak.
paraphrase.model: The immediate cause of the problem was an oil leak.

paraphrase.source: Heavy rain was the direct reason for the flood.
paraphrase.model: Heavy rain was the immediate cause of the flood.

image.value: An image showing the roots of a plant or the foundation of a building, symbolizing hidden causes.

senses.definition_vi: Nguyên nhân sâu xa, nguyên nhân gốc rễ.
examples: The underlying cause of the problem was a lack of funds over many years.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chỉ nguyên nhân cơ bản, tiềm ẩn, thường không dễ nhận thấy nhưng lại là nguồn gốc chính của vấn đề.

use_prompts.question: Why do some young people turn to crime?
Why are obesity rates rising in many countries?
Why do some countries remain poor?

dictation.text: Poverty is the underlying cause of many problems.

paraphrase.source: The deeper reason for the problem was a lack of money over many years.
paraphrase.model: The underlying cause of the problem was a lack of funds over many years.

paraphrase.source: Poor diet is the root reason for many health problems.
paraphrase.model: Poor diet is the underlying cause of many health problems.

image.value: An image of a shield deflecting an attack or a volume knob turned down, symbolizing reduction of effect.

senses.definition_vi: Giảm thiểu tác động/ảnh hưởng.
examples: The government hopes to reduce/minimise the impact of the new taxes.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Hành động nhằm làm cho ảnh hưởng của một sự kiện hoặc chính sách trở nên ít nghiêm trọng hơn.

use_prompts.question: How can governments help people cope with rising taxes?
How can airlines lessen their effect on the climate?
How can people limit the effects of stress on their health?

dictation.text: We must reduce the impact of pollution on health.

paraphrase.source: The government hopes to make the new taxes less harmful to families.
paraphrase.model: The government hopes to minimise the impact of the new taxes on families.

paraphrase.source: Airlines are trying to limit the harm they do to the environment.
paraphrase.model: Airlines are trying to reduce the impact they have on the environment.

image.value: An image of a megaphone amplifying a sound or a magnifying glass focusing light, symbolizing increased effect.

senses.definition_vi: Tăng cường tác động/ảnh hưởng.
examples: The support she got from the Prime Minister strengthened/increased the impact of her report.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Hành động làm cho ảnh hưởng của một sự kiện hoặc báo cáo trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn hoặc có ý nghĩa hơn.

use_prompts.question: How can celebrities make a news story more powerful when they support it?
What can teachers do to make their lessons more memorable for students?
How could governments make anti-pollution campaigns more effective?

dictation.text: Good photos increased the impact of her article.

paraphrase.source: The famous actor's support made the charity campaign much more powerful.
paraphrase.model: The famous actor's support strengthened the impact of the charity campaign.

paraphrase.source: Using real stories made the teacher's warning about drugs far more effective.
paraphrase.model: Using real stories increased the impact of the teacher's warning about drugs.

image.value: An image of a question mark over a result, or a path diverging unexpectedly.

senses.definition_vi: Kết quả bất ngờ, không lường trước được.
examples: The new measures had an unexpected/unforeseen outcome.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Kết quả không được dự đoán hoặc mong đợi trước đó.

use_prompts.question: Have new technologies ever caused results that nobody predicted?
What surprising results can a sudden tax increase have on ordinary families?
Has a trip of yours ever ended in a surprising way?

dictation.text: The new rule had an unexpected outcome.

paraphrase.source: Nobody predicted that the ban on cars would make the town centre so empty.
paraphrase.model: The ban on cars had an unforeseen outcome: the town centre became empty.

paraphrase.source: The election result surprised everyone in the country.
paraphrase.model: The election had an unexpected outcome that surprised everyone in the country.

image.value: An image of a clear path leading to a known destination, or a scale tipping predictably.

senses.definition_vi: Kết quả có thể đoán trước, kết quả không thể tránh khỏi.
examples: The new tax led to the predictable/inevitable outcome that many people became poorer.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Kết quả mà người ta có thể dự đoán hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra dựa trên các điều kiện hoặc hành động ban đầu.

use_prompts.question: What usually happens when prices rise much faster than wages?
What happens to people who eat junk food every day for years?
What happens when students never revise before their exams?

dictation.text: Losing the match was a predictable outcome.

paraphrase.source: Everyone knew that the factory would close after it lost its biggest customer.
paraphrase.model: The closure of the factory was the predictable outcome of losing its biggest customer.

paraphrase.source: If a country keeps cutting down its forests, floods will certainly follow.
paraphrase.model: Floods are the inevitable outcome of cutting down a country's forests.

image.value: An image of a thumbs-up sign or a growing plant, symbolizing positive results.

senses.definition_vi: Những tác động/ảnh hưởng tích cực, có lợi.
examples: The positive/beneficial effects of the changes were soon apparent.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Những kết quả tốt đẹp hoặc có lợi từ một sự kiện, hành động hoặc thay đổi.

use_prompts.question: What good results can regular exercise have on young people?
In what ways has the internet helped society?
How does travelling abroad help young people develop?

dictation.text: Regular exercise has many positive effects on health.

paraphrase.source: Learning a second language is good for children's brains in many ways.
paraphrase.model: Learning a second language has many beneficial effects on children's brains.

paraphrase.source: The new park has helped the local community a lot.
paraphrase.model: The new park has had positive effects on the local community.

image.value: An image of a downward-trending graph or a storm cloud, symbolizing negative results.

senses.definition_vi: Những tác động/ảnh hưởng tiêu cực, bất lợi.
examples: The negative/adverse effects of the changes were not noticed immediately.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Những kết quả xấu hoặc có hại từ một sự kiện, hành động hoặc thay đổi.

use_prompts.question: What harm can social media do to teenagers?
How does air pollution damage people's health in big cities?
What happens to workers who do long hours of overtime every week?

dictation.text: Too much screen time has negative effects on children.

paraphrase.source: Working night shifts can harm your sleep and your mood.
paraphrase.model: Working night shifts can have negative effects on your sleep and your mood.

paraphrase.source: Some medicines can cause serious health problems if you take too much.
paraphrase.model: Some medicines can have adverse effects if you take too much.

image.value: An image showing a straight line connecting a cause to its effect, or a chain reaction.

senses.definition_vi: Kết quả trực tiếp, kết quả không thể tránh khỏi.
examples: The crisis was the direct/inevitable result of bad economic planning.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Kết quả xảy ra một cách tự nhiên và không thể tránh khỏi từ một nguyên nhân cụ thể.

use_prompts.question: Why are more floods happening in coastal cities these days?
Why are so many young people now overweight?
Why do many small shops close when a big supermarket opens nearby?

dictation.text: Her success was the direct result of hard work.

paraphrase.source: The traffic jams happen mainly because there are too many cars in the city.
paraphrase.model: The traffic jams are a direct result of having too many cars in the city.

paraphrase.source: When a business loses money for years, it will certainly close one day.
paraphrase.model: Closure is the inevitable result of a business losing money for years.

image.value: An image showing ripples spreading outwards from a stone dropped in water, symbolizing indirect consequences.

senses.definition_vi: Kết quả gián tiếp, kết quả không lường trước được.
examples: One indirect/unforeseen result of the new laws has been a rise in unemployment.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Kết quả không phải là hệ quả trực tiếp hoặc không được dự đoán trước từ một hành động hoặc sự kiện.

use_prompts.question: What surprising changes has working from home brought to city centres?
What unexpected changes have smartphones brought to family life?
Can laws designed to help people sometimes cause problems later on?

dictation.text: One indirect result of the strike was higher prices.

paraphrase.source: The new motorway also caused, without anyone planning it, the closure of many village shops.
paraphrase.model: An indirect result of the new motorway was the closure of many village shops.

paraphrase.source: Nobody expected that cheap flights would cause such crowding in old cities.
paraphrase.model: One unforeseen result of cheap flights has been crowding in old cities.

image.value: An image of a crowd protesting loudly or people shouting angrily.

senses.definition_vi: Gây ra sự náo động, phản đối dữ dội.
examples: The book caused an uproar in the United States.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc gây ra sự phản đối mạnh mẽ hoặc sự ồn ào từ công chúng.

use_prompts.question: What kinds of news stories make the public very angry?
Why do some new laws lead to large public protests?
Can you think of a film or book that made people really angry?

dictation.text: The new tax caused an uproar across the country.

paraphrase.source: The decision to close the hospital made local people extremely angry.
paraphrase.model: The decision to close the hospital caused an uproar among local people.

paraphrase.source: The politician's rude comment led to loud protests online.
paraphrase.model: The politician's rude comment caused an uproar online.

image.value: An image of someone looking regretful or facing a negative outcome after an action.

senses.definition_vi: Gánh chịu hậu quả.
examples: If you make her angry, you’ll have to suffer the consequences.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chịu đựng những kết quả tiêu cực do hành động của mình gây ra.

use_prompts.question: What happens later to people who smoke when they are young?
Will future generations pay for our pollution today?
What happens to students who copy their essays from the internet?

dictation.text: If you cheat, you must suffer the consequences.

paraphrase.source: Drivers who break the speed limit should accept the punishment that follows.
paraphrase.model: Drivers who break the speed limit should suffer the consequences.

paraphrase.source: If we ignore climate change now, our children will pay the price.
paraphrase.model: If we ignore climate change now, our children will suffer the consequences.

image.value: An image showing a large ripple spreading across a pond, symbolizing a significant impact.

senses.definition_vi: Có ảnh hưởng lớn.
examples: The accident had a huge effect on her life.
grammar_patterns: have a huge effect on someone/something
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả một tác động mạnh mẽ và đáng kể.

use_prompts.question: Which person or event has changed your life the most?
How did the smartphone change the way people communicate?
Which teacher influenced you a lot when you were at school?

dictation.text: The move to the city had a huge effect on him.

paraphrase.source: The pandemic changed the way people work a great deal.
paraphrase.model: The pandemic had a huge effect on the way people work.

paraphrase.source: My grandmother changed my attitude to life enormously.
paraphrase.model: My grandmother had a huge effect on my attitude to life.

image.value: An image of a large wave hitting a shore, symbolizing a significant influence.

senses.definition_vi: Có tác động lớn, có ảnh hưởng quan trọng.
examples: Latino singers have had a major impact on pop music this year.
grammar_patterns: have a major impact on someone/something
senses.usage_notes_vi: Tương tự 'had a huge effect', nhấn mạnh sự ảnh hưởng quan trọng hoặc có quy mô lớn.

use_prompts.question: Which invention of the last fifty years changed society the most?
How did the recent heatwaves affect farming in your country?
Which foreign culture has influenced young people in your country strongly?

dictation.text: The internet had a major impact on daily life.

paraphrase.source: Cheap flights changed the tourism industry a lot.
paraphrase.model: Cheap flights had a major impact on the tourism industry.

paraphrase.source: Korean music strongly influenced teenage fashion in Asia.
paraphrase.model: Korean music had a major impact on teenage fashion in Asia.

image.value: An image of someone frowning or looking displeased after an interaction.

senses.definition_vi: Tạo ấn tượng xấu.
examples: Remember that it makes/creates a bad impression if you’re late.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc gây ra một cảm nhận tiêu cực ban đầu về ai đó hoặc điều gì đó.

use_prompts.question: What should candidates avoid doing in a job interview?
